dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, I made a mistake at work, too. Do you remember the English brochure I wrote?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, aɪ ˈmeɪd ə mɪˈsteɪk ət ˈwɜːrk, ˈtuː. duː juː rɪˈmɛmbər ði ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ broʊˈʃʊr aɪ ˈroʊt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The one for your company's new customer?
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwʌn fər jʊr ˈkʌmpəniz ˈnuː ˈkʌstəmər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. The customer found three spelling mistakes in it, in front of my manager.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈkʌstəmər ˈfaʊnd ˈθriː ˈspɛlɪŋ mɪˈsteɪks ɪn ɪt, ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! You could have asked me to check it! I would have helped out.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! juː kʊd hæv ˈæskt miː tə ˈtʃɛk ɪt! aɪ wʊd hæv ˈhɛlpt ˈaʊt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I didn't want to bother you. You were so busy.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈwɑːnt tə ˈbɑːðər juː. juː wɜːr soʊ ˈbɪzi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It would only have taken ten minutes! You might have saved yourself a lot of embarrassment.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʊd ˈoʊnli hæv ˈteɪkən ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts! juː maɪt hæv ˈseɪvd jʊrˈsɛlf ə ˈlɑːt əv ɪmˈbærəsmənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My colleague saw the brochure first. She could have pointed out the mistakes, but she didn't say anything.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈkɑːliːɡ ˈsɔː ðə broʊˈʃʊr ˈfɜːrst. ʃiː kʊd hæv ˈpɔɪntɪd ˈaʊt ðə mɪˈsteɪks, bʌt ʃiː ˈdɪdənt ˈseɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe she didn't notice. Did anyone warn you that the customer was very strict?
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi ʃiː ˈdɪdənt ˈnoʊtɪs. dɪd ˈɛniwʌn ˈwɔːrn juː ðæt ðə ˈkʌstəmər wʌz ˈvɛri ˈstrɪkt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No! Someone could have warned me.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! ˈsʌmwʌn kʊd hæv ˈwɔːrnd miː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well, next time, send it to me first. It'll save time in the end.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, ˈsɛnd ɪt tə miː ˈfɜːrst. ˈɪtəl ˈseɪv ˈtaɪm ɪn ði ˈɛnd.
